workouts.title: TTBT 1.1 (Week 1, Workout 1)
workouts.description: We’re kicking off your Day 1 Toes to Bar journey by setting some baseline numbers and working on the foundational shapes that support the movement. While today’s testing includes a Max Kipping Toes to Bar attempt, don’t be discouraged if your current score is zero. That’s exactly why you’re here — to improve. This baseline is just the starting point for the progress we’ll build over the next eight weeks. Make sure to download the Toes to Bar Transformed Score Sheet from the Files tab under this lesson to record your test results.

items.movement: Video and record the reps for each set
5 x Strict Bar Hanging Hollow to Arch

workouts.title: TTBT 1.2 (Week 1, Workout 2)
workouts.description: Today, we’re not just assessing your strict Toes to Bars baseline

items.movement: Video and record the reps for each set

workouts.title: TTBT 1.3 (Week 1, Workout 3)
workouts.description: Last day of Week 1 testing as we measure your L-Sit Hold and Passive Hang. Do you best with these tough movements and don’t forget to log your results in your Toes to Bar Transformed Score Card. Tracking your progress is a key part of your journey.

workouts.title: TTBT 2.1 (Week 2, Workout 1)
workouts.description: Today is all about dialling in your timing. Videoing and reviewing your attempts will help you sharpen your technique, track your progress, and spot key areas to improve. You can also share your video with a WODprep Coach through Academy coaching to get actionable feedback and tips. Want to add optional Grip Strength accessory work to your training? Click the Day 1 of Grip Strength Goals link under the SKILLS section at the end of the session. Highly recommend checking out the Grip Strength Goals Welcome Video first to get you started. You’ll see optional Grip Strength links in Week 2, 3, 5, 6 & 7.

items.movement: 6 x Strict Bar Hanging Hollow to Arch
Accumulate 60 seconds in as few sets as possible

workouts.title: TTBT 2.2 (Week 2, Workout 2)
workouts.description: Shoulder health and back strength are key to long-term fitness and overall health. Today, we’re putting the spotlight on these areas and building your strict strength as a foundation for progress. We’re also introducing Tempo Training, a method that adds controlled timing to each phase of a movement to ensure it’s properly challenging, rather than just rushing through reps. Tempo is expressed using four-digits, each number represents a specific phase: the lowering phase, bottom position, lifting phase, and top position. For example, today’s workout includes 6 x Strict Leg Raises @ 2110. That means you’ll take 2 seconds to lower your legs, pause for 1 second at the bottom, raise your legs with no pause, and hold the top position for 0 seconds before repeating.

items.movement: No barbell for the Floor T2B set-up?
Use KB or anything sturdy to hold onto

sections.name: GRIP STRENGTH (OPTIONAL)
sections.format: Add in Day 2 of Grip Strength Goals.

workouts.title: TTBT 2.3 (Week 2, Workout 3)
workouts.description: Today is all about building hip flexor strength and endurance. Don’t be surprised if you feel some quad cramping, that’s it’s totally normal. Just part of the process when we focus on areas that don’t usually get this kind of attention.

items.movement: Accumulate 60 seconds in as few sets as possible

workouts.title: TBTT 3.1 (Week 3, Workout 1)
workouts.description: Today we’re introducing a game-changer for your Toes to Bar: the Hollow Hop-in. Whether you’re working on strict or kipping reps, the Hollow Hop involves jumping to the bar in a strong hollow body position, then riding that shape into an arch. This helps generate the momentum needed to hit that first rep and sets you up to connect reps more efficiently. For a deeper dive into the Hollow Hop-in, check out the Fault Fixer video on the Dead Stop Fault. It breaks down the movement and common mistakes in more detail.

items.movement: 4 x Hollow Hop-in Kips (1 rep every 10sec)
8 x Strict Bar Hanging Hollow to Arch
8 x Beat Swings with Knee Tuck

workouts.title: TTBT 3.2 (Week 3, Workout 2)
workouts.description: Today’s session is a solid mix of shoulder and lat activation, plus strict strength work. A little bit of everything to keep building that upper body control and power.

items.movement: 3-5 x Jefferson Curls (Slow with light weight)
Accumulate 1 minute in as few sets as possible
10 x Straight Arm Band Lat Pulldown
30sec Straight Arm, Straight Leg Bear Crawl
Accumulate 90 seconds (each leg) in as few sets as possible

workouts.title: TTBT 3.3 (Week 3, Workout 3)
workouts.description: Stopping power is important, especially when lowering your feet in Toes to Bar and setting up for the next rep. Today’s training will help you better understand the activation required to control your body in space.

items.movement: 10sec x Hollow Body Rock + 20sec Hollow Body Hold
8 x Strict Bar Hanging Hollow to Arch
Accumulate 60 seconds in as few sets as possible

workouts.title: TTBT 4.1 (Week 4, Workout 1)
workouts.description: Today, we’re revisiting the strict Toes to Bar test to measure the progress from all that hold and hang work. No worries if this movement still feels far off or if your test results aren’t as impressive as you’d hoped. This entire week is simply a check-in, not an evaluation of improvement. Remember, progress isn’t always linear, and building real strength takes time. What matters most is showing up, staying consistent, and trusting the process. If you’ve been following the optional accessory grip work, it will resume in Week 5.

items.movement: Video and record the reps for each set
Not there yet with Strict Toes to Bar?
Modify to Max Strict Leg Raises to 90 degrees

workouts.title: TTBT 4.2 (Week 4, Workout 2)
workouts.description: Get ready for a solid dose of strict strength work — shoulders, midline, and grip are all in the spotlight today. We’re also checking in with a test of your L-Sit Hold and Passive Hang to see how things are progressing.

items.movement: 5 x Strict Leg Raises to 90 degrees @3110
10 x Straight Arm Band Lat Pulldown
Legs straight! Stop once you can't hold your feet up at 90 degree
Test ends when you let go of the bar
Record the times for both tests

workouts.title: TTBT 4.3 (Week 4, Workout 3)
workouts.description: We’re at the halfway point! Time to check in on your Kipping Toes to Bar. Stay tight and controlled, and pay close attention to your positions — especially engaging your lats with every rep. Just like with the Strict Toes to Bar test, don’t stress if your results haven’t moved the needle yet. Most Toes to Bar breakthroughs happen in Weeks 6–8, as all the work you’ve been putting in starts to pay off.

items.movement: 10x Hollow Body Rock + 10sec Hollow Body Hold
6x Beat Swings with Knees to Chest
Video and record the reps for each set

workouts.title: TTBT 5.1 (Week 5, Workout 1)
workouts.description: Today we’re introducing the WODprep Toes to Bar Build Drill! This drill brings together all the positions and holds you’ve been working on over the past four weeks, combining them into a single complex that teaches your body (and brain) how to connect each piece into a smooth, efficient kipping Toes to Bar. This week, just focus on doing your best with the drill. If you don’t hit every part perfectly, no worries! Drop off the bar, shake it out, and jump back up there. Like anything technical, you’ll gets better with practice. Be sure to watch the Toes to Bar Build Drill breakdown video in the Fault Fixer series so you have a clear understanding of how the drill works before you attempt it.

items.movement: 6 x Hollow Hop-in Kips (1 rep every 6 seconds)
WODprep TTB Build Drill (2 rep build w/ 1-2 TTB to finish)
Take your toes to as close to the bar as you can while still maintaining a full kip
Accumulate 90 seconds (each leg) in as few sets as possible

workouts.title: TTBT 5.2 (Week 5, Workout 2)
workouts.description: Today might be SPICY on that midline. Stay in control of your movements and focus on your positions.

items.movement: 30sec x Straight Arm, Straight Leg Bear Crawl
Accumulate 1 minute in as few sets as possible

workouts.title: TBTT 5.3 (Week 5, Workout 3)
workouts.description: Let's continue our mid-line focus while continue to strengthen our positions through the kip. 3 Sets 30sec x Prone Sphinx Pose 10 x Left Prone Thoracic Rotations 10 x Right Prone Thoracic Rotations 10 x Seated Pike Pulses 30sec x Vertical Toe Touches 12 min EMOM min 1: 15sec x Hollow Body Rock + 20sec x Hollow Body Hold min 2: 13 x Hammer Jacks min 3: 9 x Strict Bar Hanging Hollow to Arch (Hold each position for 2 sec) min 4: 10-30sec x Hanging L-sit Hold + Accumulate 2 minutes in as few sets as possible Standing Straddle Stretch

workouts.title: TTBT 6.1 (Week 6, Workout 1)
workouts.description: As with previous weeks, when performing any Kipping Toes to Bar work (whether in the build drill or otherwise), aim to bring your toes as close to the bar as possible while maintaining a full, fluid kip that you can sustain for multiple reps. Understanding how to connect reps smoothly is more important right now than actually touching the bar, that part will come with time and consistency.

items.movement: WODprep TTB Build Drill (3rep build w/ up to 3 TTB to finish)

workouts.title: TTBT 6.2 (Week 6, Workout 2)
workouts.description: Strict strength works!

items.movement: 5 x Strict Leg Raises to 90 degrees @3110
20-30sec x Straight Arm, Straight Leg Bear Crawl
Accumulate 2 minutes in as few sets as possible

workouts.title: TTBT 6.3 (Week 6, Workout 3)
workouts.description: It’s been an amazing journey so far, so let’s take a moment to acknowledge your wins, big or small. Seriously, we’re proud of how far you’ve come. But as they say, a rolling stone gathers no moss… and we’ve got an important week of work ahead! No bar work today to give your hands a well deserved break!

items.movement: 30sec x Straight Arm, Straight Leg Bear Crawl
Accumulate 1 minute (each leg) in as few sets as possible

workouts.title: TTBT 7.1 (Week 7, Workout 1)
workouts.description: Your homework this week, if you haven’t already, is to review the entire Fault Fixer series. It’s an incredible resource that just might hold the key to unlocking your Toes to Bar as we head into this final week of work before the retest in Week 8.

items.movement: WODprep TTB Build Drill (4rep build w/ up to 4 TTB to finish)

workouts.title: TTBT 7.2 (Week 7, Workout 2)
workouts.description: Let’s check in on how your strict strength is progressing. Pay close attention to both the tempo and the suggested leg raise height during the Toes to Bar Build Drill, and stay aware of how each set feels. Small adjustments from round to round can make a big difference and might be exactly what you need to break this movement wide open.

items.movement: 30sec AMRAP x Strict Leg Raises to 135 degrees @3110
Accumulate 2 minute in as few sets as possible

workouts.title: TTBT 7.3 (Week 7, Workout 3)
workouts.description: Last day before test week! Today, we’re putting everything on display. Your grip and midline endurance will be pushed, so hang on tight and have some fun with it. That said, if your hands start to feel close to ripping, call it early and protect your progress. This also marks the end of our accessory grip strength work. We can’t wait to hear how it’s helped your Toes to Bar progress!

items.movement: 30sec x Straight Arm, Straight Leg Bear Crawl
Accumulate 2 minute (each leg) in as few sets as possible

workouts.title: TTBT 8.1 (Week 8, Workout 1)
workouts.description: Welcome to the final week of Toes to Bar Transformed! Whether it’s taken you 8 weeks or a year to get here, reaching this point is a huge accomplishment and we’re proud of your effort. Today, we’ll be re-testing our holds and comparing them to your Week 1 results. Hopefully you’ve been tracking your progress on the Toes to Bar Transformed Score Sheet, you’ll need it this week.

items.movement: Legs straight! Stop once you can't hold your feet up at 90 degree.
Test ends when you let go of the bar
Record the times for both tests

workouts.title: TTBT 8.2 (Week 8, Workout 2)
workouts.description: Day 2 of our Week 8 testing, and it’s time to revisit your Strict Toes to Bar. Tempo and control are key here, so let’s show off the strength and technique you’ve built over the past several weeks. Take your time, focus on quality reps, and be proud of how far you’ve come and the effort you’ve put in to get here.

items.movement: 30sec x Straight Arm, Straight Leg Bear Crawl
Video and record the reps for each set for Week 1 comparison
Still not there with Strict Toes to Bar?

workouts.title: TTBT 8.3 (Week 8, Workout 3)
workouts.description: Today is our final day! For some, today test might be a new PR. For others, it could be improved shapes, stronger positions, or just getting those feet a little closer to the bar. No matter what your numbers look like, we’re proud of you. We want to hear all your your success! Post your before-and-after videos on the Wall of Wins and earn yourself with some sweet WODprep swag just for sharing.

items.movement: Hollow Body Band Pull-overs (hold 2sec at top)
5 x Strict Bar Hanging Hollow to Arch
1 x WODprep TTB Build Drill (1-2rep build w/ 1-2 TTB to finish)
Video both sets and share your success on the Wall of Wins!
